x: Several of the 188 starters came under the judges' ban and Met WC lost McCullagh and Watts, a set-back from which they did well to recover. Others to be'pulled' were Paddick (RSC) and Hart, the Welsh champion.

Handbook, MIDDLE DISTANCE RUNNING by Tony Ward; STRENGTH TRAINING by Ron Pickering; CIRCUIT TRAINING by Adamson and Morgan; THE COMPLETE MIDDLE DISTANCE RUNNER by Messrs. Watts, Wilson and Horwill. I consider any middle-distance coach who hasn't got these on his shelf is missing out a lot.

Not much in it off the turn and into the straight but then Michael Johnson pattered away from the crowd to win in 31.72, leaving Olympic Champions Watts and Marsh together with the Belgrave man to fill 2nd to 4th places all within 5/100ths. 3000m: 3, G.Staines 7:51.86.
